title: Central African Republic - Climate Fact Sheet 2024
organization: Red Cross Red Crescent Climate Centre
temporal_coverage: Historical observations; projections to mid-century and beyond
methodology: Desk synthesis drawing substantially on World Bank/IPCC-type climate evidence
limitations: Not an original modelling study; some projections are regional rather than CAR-specific; rainfall/drought uncertainty is substantial.

title: Plan national initial d’adaptation aux changements climatiques de la République centrafricaine
temporal_coverage: Current planning horizon at publication and future adaptation planning
methodology: Government policy process, sector reviews, consultations and adaptation planning
limitations: Policy intentions do not demonstrate implementation or outcomes; several planned enabling activities lacked finalized budgets.

title: Contribution déterminée au niveau national 3.0 - République centrafricaine (UNFCCC)
methodology: Government inventory, planning, targets, indicators and financing framework
limitations: Self-reported baselines and targets; climate-peace-security language is policy framing, not causal evaluation.

title: First Biennial Transparency Report of the Central African Republic (UNFCCC)
methodology: Government technical reporting, inventories, adaptation assessment and self-evaluation
limitations: Government self-report; adaptation-risk analysis itself is described as largely qualitative and constrained by weak data.

title: National Adaptation Plans in Focus: Lessons from Central African Republic
methodology: Synthesis of NAP process, stakeholder consultations and implementation lessons
limitations: Short programme-supported brief; not an independent evaluation.

title: Climate, Peace and Security Fact Sheet: Central African Republic (NUPI)
geographic_coverage: CAR, with regional Sahel/Great Lakes mechanisms
methodology: Literature synthesis and expert/interview inputs organized around climate-security pathways
limitations: Explicitly acknowledges limited CAR-specific climate/security monitoring and evidence; some pathway evidence derives from comparable or regional settings.

title: Climate change in the Central African Republic: what threats? (ICRC)
organization: International Committee of the Red Cross
geographic_coverage: CAR, especially pastoral and rural contexts
methodology: Practitioner observations of climate, pastoralism, conflict and humanitarian programming
limitations: Qualitative practitioner source, not representative research; programme activities are not evaluated outcomes.

title: Central African Republic IPC Acute Food Insecurity Analysis / April-August 2026 update (IPCinfo)
methodology: Multi-partner IPC analytical framework integrating food consumption, livelihoods and contributing factors
limitations: IPC classification is analytical, not a causal attribution study; exact publication day was not visible on the opened page.

title: Central African Republic situation overview - Global Appeal 2026
temporal_coverage: Snapshot mainly Sep 2025; outlook to end-2026
methodology: Operational displacement statistics and humanitarian planning
limitations: Planning document; forward caseloads are projections; seasonal floods are only one of multiple pressures.

title: Border town doubling in size as Sudanese refugees arrive in Central African Republic (UNHCR)
methodology: Agency registration/operational statistics and programme reporting
limitations: Highly useful subnational evidence but not nationally generalizable; response activities are outputs rather than evaluated effectiveness.

title: Central African Republic Emergency Food Crisis Response Project (P176754): Implementation Status & Results Report (World Bank)
methodology: Project monitoring indicators and Bank implementation supervision
limitations: Not independent evaluation; several indicators measure reach/output rather than durable resilience.

title: Climate-Resilient Agribusiness Promotion Programme (PARCA) - President’s Report (IFAD Web Apps)
temporal_coverage: Design period from 2025 onward; includes lessons from earlier portfolio
methodology: Design appraisal plus lessons from previous IFAD operations
limitations: Most PARCA results are targets, not observed outcomes; earlier-portfolio lessons are institutional self-assessment.

title: Central African Republic - Emergency Food Crisis Response and Agriculture Re-Launch Project: Project Performance Assessment Report
geographic_coverage: CAR with fieldwork in M’Baïki, Bossembélé and Boali
methodology: Independent document review, interviews and field mission
limitations: Historical rather than current; localized field observations cannot be generalized nationally.
